# Section 100: Plan And Apply Infrastructure With OpenTofu

OpenTofu is an infrastructure as code tool. It compares configuration files with the real resources, shows the changes as a plan, applies them when you ask, and records the result in a state file. This section uses OpenTofu with the Kubernetes provider, so every resource it manages is a Kubernetes object. The section is compact: it covers the OpenTofu tasks the exam simulator tests.

**Curriculum item covered:** Implementing GitOps Workflows for Application and Infrastructure Deployment

---

## What You Will Master

- Read a working directory and its existing state
- Initialize a working directory and save a human-readable plan
- Change a Deployment attribute and add a Kubernetes Service
- Compare an explicit OpenTofu apply with a controller that reconciles all the time
